content: You are a senior backend engineer working in the orders-service repository (TypeScript, Express, Postgres). Use the tools to inspect and change code. Keep answers concise. Never modify database migrations without explicit approval.

Fix the flaky integration test in src/api/orders.ts — `POST /orders > is idempotent across gateway retries` fails with a 409 on the retry. Constraints: do not touch the database schema, the migration freeze is on until Friday (ticket OPS-2291). The retry behaviour itself is correct and owned by the gateway team (ticket API-1187), so fix it on our side.
Reproducing the failure first.

> orders-service@2.14.0 test
> vitest run test/orders.test.ts

 RUN  v3.1.4 /workspace/orders-service

 ❯ test/orders.test.ts (6 tests | 1 failed) 1432ms
   ✓ POST /orders > creates an order 88ms
   ✓ POST /orders > rejects an empty cart 12ms
   × POST /orders > is idempotent across gateway retries 1204ms
     → Expected status 201 but received 409 (Conflict): duplicate idempotency key "ord-7f3a9c" — first attempt was rolled back after a simulated timeout, second attempt must succeed
     ❯ test/orders.test.ts:71:5
     ❯ handler src/api/orders.ts:41:9
   ✓ GET /orders/:id > returns 404 for unknown ids 9ms
   ✓ GET /orders/:id > returns the order 15ms
   ✓ DELETE /orders/:id > soft-deletes 21ms

 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 5 passed (6)
   Start at  09:41:07
   Duration  2.19s
Reading the handler the stack trace points at.

The handler records the idempotency key before the transaction commits. When the first attempt is rolled back after the gateway timeout, the key is already remembered, so the retry is rejected with 409. I will look at the idempotency module next.
